title: Wall-slam A — gather-tool multi-host chains (pickaxe / hatchet / mattock / Imcando)
scope: Pickaxe progression checklist (dragon → Imcando → crystal → Earth and Song → Life and Death)
Imcando tools family (pickaxe, hatchet, related craft pressure)
Hatchet progression checklist (dragon → Imcando → crystal → Ember and Glade → Bloom and Blight)
Mattock progression checklist (dragon → crystal / Imcando → MoTaS → Tony)
outOfScope: Always Adze (Seed of the Charyou Tree) — kandarin-only separate (not this pack)
Auto-burn Woodcutting paths / Bait and Switch dual-monolith stacks

userLock.Pickaxe of Life and Death: fremennik + tirannwn + asgarnia (Ice Mountain / Sacred Forge)
userLock.Pickaxe of Earth and Song: fremennik + tirannwn + kandarin (Ancient Cavern dragon forge)
userLock.Always Adze: kandarin-only separate — do not merge into hatchet ladders

unobtainableTag: UNOBTAINABLE under Equilibrium 3-elective cap (region pressure exceeds picks).
policy: Honor user prior rulings over wiki detail text and over wall-slam-input host drift.
keepHosts: clamp catalog hosts to listed set; set requiredRegions on every keep host.
UNOBTAINABLE rows keep multi-host visibility (planner must still see pressure) but tag detail.
Progression checklists are residual maps — requiredRegions = union of finished-tool end of each ladder.
Do not edit catalog.json from this file alone; apply via wall-slam / region-patch apply scripts.
Always Adze stays kandarin-only and is not rewritten here.

notes: Ember vs Bloom host sets intentionally differ: user put forinthry on Ember and kept misthalin (+desert+mory) on Bloom. Do not force-merge into a single 7-region set without a new ruling.
Wiki places Ember Imcando fragments at Fort Grove (project Misthalin taxonomy) and forge at Ancient Cavern (Kandarin); user forinthry/wildy lock overrides Grove host on the finished Ember row.
Earth and Song wiki forge is Ancient Cavern dragonkin anvil (Kandarin) — agrees with user kandarin hard gate.
Life and Death materials (Mos Le'Harmless black stone, Um moonstone, Daemonheim primal ore) stay optional pressure in detail — not hard requiredRegions per user three-region lock.
Always Adze is kandarin-only and must not be folded into hatchet progression.
apply-high.mjs currently hard-removes the three progression checklists before merging agent patches — if that stays, checklist keepHosts ops are no-ops after remove; finished-tool rows still apply.
